study type: Multicenter retrospective analysis with machine learning model development
outcome: Surgical morbidity composite (blood loss >1,500 mL, transfusion, intensive care unit admission, vasopressor use, mechanical ventilation/intubation, organ injury)
cohort: 401 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) confirmed by pathology specimen across five tertiary care perinatal centers.
finding: A machine learning model achieved an AUC of 0.79 in predicting surgical morbidity in PAS cases, with hysterectomy completion, prepregnancy BMI, absence of second trimester ultrasound, socioeconomic status, BMI at delivery, number of prenatal visits, and delivery time of day identified as the most predictive variables.
